title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: When you disagree with the umpire
hook: You think the umpire missed something. What do you do?
intro: The call looks wrong from where you stand.
Your players are waiting to see how you react.
statement: Kids learn respect for officials from their coach.
q1: Do you calmly ask the umpire between innings —
t1: There is no single right way. But games stay calm
cta: Coaches — how do you handle a disagreement?
ctaLines: A calm question between innings. Let it go. Talk to the league.
ctaPrompt: Share your dugout habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
You think the umpire missed something. What do you do?
The call looks wrong from where you stand. Your players are waiting to see how you react.
Kids learn respect for officials from their coach.
A calm question or let it go. There is no perfect answer.
How do you handle a disagreement? Share your habit in the comments.
